verses.t: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
verses.pickthall: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
verses.yusufAli: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind
verses.rodwell: SAY: I betake me for refuge to the Lord of MEN
verses.sale: Say, I fly for refuge unto the Lord of men

verses.t: From the evil of the retreating whisperer
verses.pickthall: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer
verses.yusufAli: From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper)
verses.rodwell: Against the mischief of the stealthily withdrawing whisperer
verses.sale: that He may deliver me from the mischief of the whisperer who slyly withdraweth

verses.t: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind
verses.pickthall: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind
verses.yusufAli: (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind
verses.sale: who whispereth evil suggestions into the breasts of men

verses.t: From among the jinn and mankind
verses.pickthall: Of the jinn and of mankind
